paragraphs.text: Gonzalo Ferreira Luján was arrested in Operation Rompiente on 2014-11-20. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Operation Rompiente on 2014-11-20. Operation Rompiente occurred at Ensenada on 2014-11-20. Liaison reporting from a naval contact at Tuxpan, relaying an account passed along the maritime liaison channel from the Pacific coast, described the arrest of Ferreira, the head of the Tijuana crossing network known along the coast as El Timonel, aboard a panga off Ensenada. The contact stated that a marine patrol had tracked the boat the crews call Panga Coral Tres from the approaches to San Diego back toward the Ensenada coves over two nights and that the patrol boarded it at dawn with Ferreira and two crew members aboard. The contact had no information on whether cargo was recovered.

Teodoro Lizárraga Fonseca led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2014-11-23 until 2027-01-01. The contact stated that Lizárraga, the deputy known as El Cerrajero, assumed control of the network within days of the arrest and dated the handover to a meeting of the crossing crews some days after the boarding. The reporting office notes that other reporting places the handover on the day of the arrest itself and reports the contact's dating as given. The contact characterized the transition as orderly and said the crews had expected Lizárraga to succeed Ferreira for some time.

The reporting office assesses the liaison contact as having secondhand access to the arrest through the maritime liaison channel and no direct knowledge of the network's internal arrangements. The source reporting was received through the standard liaison channel for this agency. The reporting office will compare the leadership date given here with other agency reporting before the discrepancy is reflected in any assessment. The contact added that the panga was taken to the naval station at Ensenada and that the two crew members were released without charge, which the contact attributed to their being local fishermen hired for the crossing. A consumer with a related investigation should contact the originating office before dissemination.
